# Documentation Review & Update (post-0.33.0) — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Execute task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax. Docs-only branch — no `js/**` code changes.

**Goal:** Bring `docs/` back into truth against 0.33.0, fix the missing hero image + nav logo, and resolve the "Coming Soon" stubs — concisely, in the existing voice.

**Architecture:** VitePress site under `docs/`. `api/cli.md` + `api/config-schema.md` are generated by `docs/scripts/docs-generator.cjs`; everything else is hand-authored. Assets served from `docs/public/`.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-07-docs-review-post-0.33.0-design.md` (read it first).

## Global Constraints

- Binary is `varvis-download.cjs`; there is no `.js`. Env vars read: only `VARVIS_USER`, `VARVIS_PASSWORD`, `VARVIS_TARGET`. Precedence: CLI flag > env > config > default.
- Node >= 22.22.2, npm >= 10. Tools: samtools/tabix/bgzip only.
- Never document a feature the code lacks (resume/checksum/concurrency/perf-keys are ABSENT — grep-verified). Real: progress bar, retry+exponential backoff, plain-text report.
- Edit generated pages at the generator source, then regenerate. Prettier + `npm run docs:build` (with `ignoreDeadLinks` trimmed) must pass.
- Keep each task's diff scoped; commit per task with a `docs:` prefix.
